How Alexander Hamilton (Chernow) connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Hamilton the musical is adapted from Ron Chernow's biography.
  • Character: Ron Chernow — Ron Chernow wrote the biography Alexander Hamilton.
  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Chernow's Alexander Hamilton was adapted into the musical.

What is Alexander Hamilton (Chernow)?

Alexander Hamilton is Ron Chernow's biography of the Treasury secretary, the source book Miranda carried into Hamilton and the work the musical is officially adapted from.
